title: Linux privilege escalation enumeration runner: SUID/SGID binaries, sudo misconfigurations, writable cron jobs, and path hijacking
goal: AutoPenBench's Access Control tasks cover: weak sudo passwords, file permissions, and SETUID misconfiguration — 20% autonomous success, 80% assisted. AegisPT has no Linux privilege escalation enumeration. Implement a priv-esc-linux runner (equivalent to LinPEAS/unix-privesc-check): (1) SUID/SGID binary enumeration: find all SUID/SGID binaries (find / -perm -4000 2>/dev/null), compare against GTFOBins list of exploitable binaries (bash, vim, nmap, python, find, cp, awk, etc.). Finding: 'SUID Binary Exploitable via GTFOBins: /usr/bin/find'. (2) Sudo misconfiguration: run sudo -l and parse output. Check for: ALL=(ALL:ALL) ALL, NOPASSWD entries, specific dangerous commands (vi, less, more, python, bash). Finding: 'Sudo NOPASSWD - Privilege Escalation Possible'. (3) Writable cron jobs: check /etc/cron* and /var/spool/cron/ for world-writable scripts. Finding: 'Writable Cron Script — Privilege Escalation via Cron'. (4) Path hijacking: check for writable directories in $PATH before system directories. (5) Weak file permissions: check world-writable /etc/passwd, /etc/shadow readable, backup files with credentials. (6) Kernel exploits: check kernel version against known local privilege escalation CVEs (CVE-2021-3156 Baron Samedit, CVE-2022-0847 DirtyPipe). Intrusive-credential tier — requires SSH access to target with low-privilege shell. Findings critical severity. WIZARD WIRING (mandatory): (1) Add to api/app/services/run_profiles.py: name=intrusive-credential-priv-esc-linux, run_class=ACTIVE, tools=[priv-esc-linux], required_approvals=1, approval_step_id: intrusive-credential-priv-esc-linux, requires_auth_context: True. (2) Add profile intrusive-credential-priv-esc-linux to FULL-INTERNAL-LAN Phase 3 in api/app/services/assessment_chain.py. (3) Add to wizard.js resolveExecutionProfile: when Internal LAN or Full Internal tile + full depth + credential context, include intrusive-credential-priv-esc-linux in planned profiles. (4) Add to scripts/acceptance_harness.py PROFILE_TOOL_MAP: intrusive-credential-priv-esc-linux: [priv-esc-linux].
scope: AutoPenBench Access Control tasks: 20% autonomous SR, 80% assisted SR. AegisPT has no Linux priv esc. SUID/sudo enumeration is a standard pentest task. Equivalent to LinPEAS but scoped and safety-bounded.
generation_reason: AutoPenBench AC tasks (SUID, sudo, file permissions) not covered by AegisPT. LinPEAS-equivalent runner required for post-exploitation privilege path enumeration.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Enumeration only — find and report exploitable paths. Do not execute exploits. Do not escalate privileges. Do not write to target filesystem.
constraints.safety: Read-only enumeration. Never execute found SUID binaries for exploitation. Finding reports the vector; exploitation requires separate Metasploit runner with intrusive-exploitation gate.

success_criteria: priv-esc-linux runner enumerates SUID binaries and matches against GTFOBins.
Sudo -l output parsed and dangerous entries produce findings.
Kernel version checked against known local priv esc CVEs.
Runner reachable via wizard when: Internal LAN or Full Internal tile + full depth + credential context.
